tools.name: ash_read

meta.description: Include encoding and mtime in the pretty header.

range.description: start:end range, 1-based inclusive; end clamped to file length.

size.description: size of the file on disk

truncation_hint.description: Truncation hint: how many records were dropped and the caps that triggered the drop.

max.description: Hard cap (max possible value of limit).

tools.name: ash_find
tools.description: Walk a directory tree and return matching paths; respects .gitignore.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

depth.description: Max depth; 0 is unlimited, 1 is direct children only.

exclude.description: Doublestar pattern; matching entries are skipped.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

hidden.description: Include directories starting with '.' when true.

meta.description: Show type, size, and date per row; default is path only.

size.description: bytes; omitted for dirs and symlinks

truncation_hint.description: Truncation hint: how many records were dropped and the caps that triggered the drop.

max.description: Hard cap (max possible value of limit).

tools.name: ash_grep
tools.description: Search files for an RE2 pattern; skips binary and files >16 MiB.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

ca.description: Context lines after each match; max 50.

case.description: Case sensitivity; smart is insensitive unless pattern has uppercase.

cb.description: Context lines before each match; max 50.

fo.description: Return only paths of files with at least one match.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

glob.description: Doublestar pattern; scan only matching files.

hidden.description: Include directories starting with '.' when true.

lit.description: Treat pattern as literal text, not a regex.

max.description: Max total match records; hard cap 4096.

mpf.description: Max match records per file; 0 is unlimited.

multiline.description: Match against the whole file body so patterns can span lines.

no-text.description: Omit matched line text; render path:line:col only.

pattern.description: RE2 regex; literal text when lit=true.

file_count.description: distinct files with at least one match

col.description: 1-indexed byte column of the first match start; only on match records

truncation_hint.description: Truncation hint: how many records were dropped and the caps that triggered the drop.

max.description: Hard cap (max possible value of limit).

tools.name: ash_git
tools.description: Structured git calls via --op discriminator: status, log, diff, show.

author.description: [op=log] Filter commits by author name or email substring.

bytes.description: [op=diff|show] Max patch bytes; omits patch past cap, preserves stats. Max 4 MiB.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

limit.description: [op=log] Max commits to return; hard cap 200.

path.description: Any path inside the git worktree; output is repo-root-relative.

pathspec.description: [op=log|diff|show] Restrict to a path, repo-root-relative, passed after --.

ref.description: [op=show] Commit ref for show: SHA, branch, tag, HEAD~1. Required.

since.description: [op=log] Only commits after this date; accepts git --since formats.

staged.description: [op=diff] Diff index vs HEAD; default diffs worktree vs index.

stat.description: [op=diff|show] Return per-file add/delete counts only; no patch text.

context_elided.description:
ContextElided is true when one or more hunks in Patch had their
context (" "-prefixed) lines collapsed into an inline sentinel to
fit the budget. Changed lines (+ / -) are always preserved.

hunks_shown.description:
HunksShown is how many hunks Patch actually contains. Counts a
context-elided hunk as 1.

hunks_total.description:
HunksTotal is the number of hunks the upstream patch contained.
Zero when there were none (binary, pure rename, etc.) or when the
patch was not truncated (the field omits-on-zero on the wire).

patch_truncated.description:
PatchTruncated is true when Patch contains fewer bytes than the
raw upstream patch — either because hunks were dropped (multi-hunk
overflow), context lines were elided (single huge hunk), or the
patch was omitted entirely (per-file budget exhausted).

truncation_hint.description: Truncation hint: how many records were dropped and the caps that triggered the drop.

max.description: Hard cap (max possible value of limit).

tools.name: ash_write
tools.description: Write a file atomically; creates parent directories by default.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

content.description: File content; pass '-' to read from stdin.

encoding.description: Content encoding; use base64 for binary files.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

no-clobber.description: Fail with 'exists' if the file already exists.

created.description: true if file did not exist before the write

tools.name: ash_metrics
tools.description: Query recent call history from the ledger.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

verb.description: Filter to calls for a specific verb.

tokens_cache_hit.description:
ASH-108 prompt-cache accounting reported back by the harness.
Zero for daemon-originated rows; populated only when the call
carried Anthropic cache_read_input_tokens telemetry.

tokens_out_emit.description:
ASH-123 MCP-transport emit accounting. Non-zero only for rows
where the request arrived via `ashmcp`; the JSON `tools/call`
emit is the cost the harness actually paid.

tools.name: ash_report
tools.description: Per-verb ledger summary: n, ok%, p50/p95 latency, tokens, trunc%.

all.description: Aggregate across every installed repo; includes per-root breakdown.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

last.description: Row cap after session/since filters; max 5000.

root.description: Project root to query read-only; mutually exclusive with --all.

session.description: Session scope: current, all, or explicit session ID.

since.description: Time window (e.g. 15m, 1h, 7d); supports Go duration + d.

top.description: Max entries in truncation and error histogram sections.

verb.description: Restrict aggregation to calls for a specific verb.

by_root.description:
ByRoot is populated only by --all-roots: per-ledger contribution
counts, in registry order. Empty for single-root reports.

root.description:
Root is the project root whose ledger was queried. Empty when the
daemons own ledger is in use; populated for --root and --all-roots
(in --all-roots, set to a sentinel "ALL" value).

roots.description:
Roots is the per-root list when --all-roots is in effect. One entry
per ledger that was successfully opened, in registry order.

mcp_calls.description:
MCPCalls counts how many of Calls arrived over `ashmcp` (i.e.
rows with non-zero bytes_out_emit). When equal to Calls the
session is MCP-only; when 0 the emit columns stay hidden.

tokens_cache_hit.description:
ASH-108 cache-aware envelope. TokensCacheHit / TokensCacheMiss
aggregate per-call Anthropic prompt-cache accounting when the
harness reports it back. CacheCalls counts how many rows in the
window carried non-zero cache numbers — used to decide whether
PrettyResponse renders the cache line at all (hidden when 0 so
CLI-only sessions are byte-identical to today's output).

tokens_out_emit.description:
TokensOutEmit / BytesOutEmit are the MCP-envelope accounting from
ASH-123: what the harness actually consumed for rows where the
request arrived over `ashmcp`. Both are 0 for CLI-only sessions
and PrettyResponse hides them in that case.

sample_args.description: decoded from first truncated call's args_msgpack

tools.name: ash_recap
tools.description: Compact session summary: files touched, patterns searched, edits made.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

since.description: Time window (e.g. 15m, 1h, 24h); supports Go duration + d.

tools.name: ash_workspace
tools.description: Re-orientation snapshot: relevant files, recent searches, branch + status, last error.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

since.description: Time window for relevance, default 30m; max 24h.

last_ts.description: LastTs is the most recent touch time (UnixNano).

last_verb.description:
LastVerb is the most recent verb that touched the file (read,
edit, write, grep, etc.); useful for the agent to decide what
it was doing.

available.description:
Available is false when no git repo was detected; the rest of
the struct is then meaningless and PrettyResponse skips the line.

hits.description:
Hits is the number of grep matches reported by the call (-1 if
unknown — we read it from the call's tokens_out histogram).

tools.name: ash_replay
tools.description: Re-run prior ledger calls; report per-verb token deltas vs originals.

cache_prefix.description: Add per-verb cache-prefix A/B (ASH-108) to the result.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

limit.description: Cap on calls replayed; 0 is no cap, hard ceiling 5000.

regress_tokens.description: Δtokens% threshold for tagging a row as a regression.

session.description: Session scope: current, all, or explicit session ID.

since.description: Time window (e.g. 1h, 7d); supports Go duration + d.

top.description: Max rows in the top-regressors section.

verb.description: Restrict to calls for a specific verb.

tools.name: ash_help
tools.description: Return argument schema for one verb or all verbs.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

verb.description: Verb name to describe; omit for all verbs.

long.description: verbose-only prose; shipped when non-empty so client renderer can surface it

ops.description: [git] which ops this arg applies to; empty = global

tools.name: ash_hook
tools.description: PreToolUse decision engine; steers harness tools to ash equivalents.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

path.description: Grep/Glob search root or Read path.

reason.description: human-readable deny reason (matches what Claude shows)

tools.name: ash_stat
tools.description: Return lstat metadata for one or more paths.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

follow.description: Resolve symlinks; broken symlinks produce error=broken_symlink per entry.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

path.description: Single-path alias for --paths; one of --paths or --path required.

paths.description: Comma-separated paths to inspect; one of --paths or --path required.

errors.description: entries with a non-empty Error field

tools.name: ash_edit
tools.description: Atomically edit a file: string-replace, line-range, or patch mode.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

all.description: [mode=string] Replace every occurrence; false errors if old appears multiple times.

dry.description: Compute the replacement without writing; result includes unified diff.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

new.description: [mode=string] Replacement text; empty string deletes the match. / [mode=range] Replacement lines; empty string deletes the range.

old.description: [mode=string] Exact text to find; must appear once unless all=true.

patch.description: [mode=patch] Unified diff to apply; pass '-' to read from stdin.

range.description: [mode=range] start:end line range to replace, 1-based inclusive.

occurrences.description: replacements made; hunk count in patch mode

tools.name: ash_diff
tools.description: Unified diff: file vs file or inline content, capped at 4000 lines.

absolute.description: Emit absolute paths instead of repo-root-relative.

content.description: Inline after-side text; pass '-' to read from stdin.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

stat.description: Return add/delete/unchanged counts only; no patch text.

unchanged.description: true when the two sides are identical

tools.name: ash_bench
tools.description: Benchmark ash vs bash; report token/latency deltas per case.

baseline.description: Run fresh bench, compare against rolling median over the window.

case.description: Run a single named case; overrides --verb.

compare.description: Compare two persisted runs; 'latest' resolves to most recent.

diff_micro.description: Run micro bench and compare against bench/microbench.json.

export_md.description: Render latest bench run as Markdown.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

limit.description: Cap cases after filters; 0 is no cap.

list.description: List recent persisted bench runs and exit.

micro.description: Run Go Benchmark* functions for curated hot-path packages.

micro_count.description: go test -count for --micro mode; 1 runs each benchmark once per benchtime window.

micro_packages.description: Comma-separated package paths for --micro; default: curated hot-path set.

record_baseline.description: Run fresh bench; write baseline.json, baseline.md, latency-snapshot.json.

record_micro.description: Run micro bench and write bench/microbench.json + bench/microbench.md.

regress_latency.description: Latency delta % threshold for regression in --compare.

regress_tokens.description: Token delta % threshold for regression in --compare.

repeat.description: Measured iterations per case; >1 enables p50 and min latency.

verb.description: Restrict to cases for one verb.

warmup.description: Unmeasured warm-up iterations; defaults to 1 when repeat>1.

tools.name: ash_test
tools.description: Run Go tests; return structured per-test results.

bench.description: go test -bench pattern; implies -run=^$ when --run is unset.

count.description: go test -count; 1 bypasses cache, 0 uses cache.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

packages.description: Comma-separated package patterns for go test.

run.description: Regex for go test -run; filters tests.

timeout.description: Timeout; also passed to go test -timeout.

verbose.description: Include passing test names per package.

tools.name: ash_uninit

elapsed_ms.description: wall time from first signal to confirmed exit (or timeout)

exited.description: true if process is gone post-cleanup

tools.name: ash_usage
tools.description: Annotate a prior call with Anthropic prompt-cache hit/miss tokens.

for.description: request_id of a specific prior call; default is the most recent non-usage call.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

tools.name: ash_lang
tools.description: Semantic queries via the LSP broker: outline, def, refs, callers, impl.

context.description: [op=refs|callers|impl] Include the source line at each match.

format.description: Response shape: "json" (default) ships structured data as TextContent; "pretty" ships the daemon-pretty text and skips structuredContent, matching CLI token cost. MCP-only knob; ignored on the CLI.

in.description: [op=def|refs|callers|impl] Optional file/directory scope (comma-separated) — narrow which candidates the symbol/interface resolution considers.

internal-only.description: [op=def|refs|callers|impl] Drop candidates from $GOROOT and module cache; pass false to include them.

path.description: [op=outline] File to outline; required for op=outline.

symbol.description: [op=def|refs|callers] Symbol name to find; required for def/refs/callers.

context_line.description:
ContextLine is the single line of source at Line (for refs/callers
when --context=true). Trimmed of leading whitespace; capped at
~200 chars so a single long line cannot blow the response.
